The original UNRESOLVED label conflates two distinct questions. The supplied sources expressly describe the challenged subletting as involving 'the premises,' which is enough to support the literal whole-or-any-part scope proposition. Whether a legally qualifying disposition actually occurred remains separate and unresolved by this row. C07 should therefore be SUPPORTED for scope only, without implying that subletting, assignment, or parting with possession was proved.
